ud1.8:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji Sāvatthiṃ anuppatto hoti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. assosi kho āyasmato Saṅgamajissa purāṇadutiyikā: ayyo Saṅgāmaji Sāvatthiṃ anuppatto 'ti. sā dārakam ādāya Jetavanam agamāsi.
ud1.8:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinno hoti. atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā yena āyasmā Saṅgāmaji ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: Khudda{putt'amhi,} samaṇa posa man ti. evaṃ vutte āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi
ud1.8:3.1: dutiyam pi kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: Khuddaputtaṃ hi samaṇa posa man ti. dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi.
ud1.8:4.1: tatiyam pi kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ etad avoca: khuddaputtaṃ hi samaṇa posa man ti. tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji tuṇhī ahosi.
ud1.8:5.1: atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā taṃ dārakaṃ āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purato nikkhipitvā pakkāmi: eso te samaṇa putto, posa nan ti.
ud1.8:6.1: atha kho āyasmā Saṅgāmaji taṃ dārakaṃ neva olokesi nāpi ālapi. atha kho āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikā avidūre gantvā apalokentī addas' āyasmantaṃ Saṅgāmajiṃ taṃ dārakaṃ neva olokentaṃ nāpi ālapantaṃ, disvān 'assā etad ahosi: na c' āyaṃ samaṇo puttena pi atthiko 'ti tato patinivattitvā dārakaṃ ādāya pakkāmi. addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena āyasmato Saṅgāmajissa purāṇadutiyikāya evarūpaṃ vippakāraṃ.
ud1.8:7.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud1.8:8.1: āyantiṃ nābhinandati, pakkāmantiṃ na socati, saṅgā Saṅgāmajiṃ muttaṃ tam ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇan ti. ||8||
